_meta.source: npf-fpn.ca, wsib.ca, cupe.ca, iaff.org/canada, laws-lois.justice.gc.ca, ipc.on.ca
_meta.maintainer: Update annually. Verify WSIB rates each January. Confirm PTSD presumption proclamation dates. Check NPF CBA expiry (current: 2021-2025).
_meta.update_procedure: 1. Verify legislative citations at laws-lois.justice.gc.ca. 2. Confirm WSIB/WCB rates at wsib.ca / worksafebc.com. 3. Check NPF CBA renewal date. 4. Bump version date. 5. Redeploy.
_meta.jurisdiction_note: Ontario used as primary provincial example. BC/AB/other provinces: substitute FOIPPA for MFIPPA, WCB for WSIB, and applicable provincial acts. RCMP is always federal regardless of province of posting.
_meta.disclaimer: This tool provides general information only. It is not legal advice. Verify all citations with the authoritative statute text at laws-lois.justice.gc.ca.

benefits.name: RCMP Duty-Related Disability Benefit

conditions.label: Member of the RCMP (Regular or Civilian Member)

Request via Privacy Act ATIP to RCMP National Division

form_questions: What is your rank and badge number?
What injury or condition are you claiming?
What specific incident or operational exposure caused this condition?
Are you currently fit for duty, on modified duties, or medically released?

benefits.name: RCMP Survivor / Death-in-Service Benefit
